Body.Content:
Credit management in Dynamics 365 Finance has traditionally applied one credit limit to each customer account. That makes it hard to see which parts of a customer's business are using credit and where the risk is. Credit segments let organizations divide a customer's total credit limit into separate allocations by line of business, such as product line, division, business unit or region. Different credit policies can then apply to each line of business while the customer keeps one overall credit ceiling. Credit managers define segments, split the customer's total limit across them and see available credit for each segment in real time. Built-in checks stop the segment allocations from adding up to more than the customer's total limit. Transactions are checked against the credit available in their assigned segment, and orders or contracts that would go over it can be put on hold for review, approval or release. The first release introduces segment setup and segment-based credit checks for rental contracts. Support for sales orders and invoices, blocking rules and temporary credit limits is planned for later releases.

GA date: October CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
